text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything, so they can improve the code without fear. In short, testing saves time and reduces stress.
